tagline: Embedded dashboard filter APIs: In embedded dashboards, you can now set and retrieve filter values through APIs.
what_it_does: Embedded dashboard filter APIs: In embedded dashboards, you can now set and retrieve filter values through APIs. Ranked table calculations in /importBI: Importing reports from Power BI and Tableau with the /importBI Genie Code command now includes ranked table calculations. Color mappings: In a dashboard's theme settings, you can assign a specific color to a value by name.
why_it_matters: Dashboard variable improvements: Enhancements to dashboard variables: + Multiple fields: Viewers can now add, remove, and swap multiple fields through a dashboard variable on a visualization, instead of switching one field at a time.
